issues.description: Light-planet comparison in sale initiative has no numerical method or universal weight table.
One literal & e contra follows lighter-significator comparison; source does not enumerate a separate prediction algorithm.
Mutually applying significators and translation of light are syntactically separated; do not conflate the no-direct-aspect premise with direct conjunction.
Open-ended goods classification does not supply a complete list; analogical houses for unlisted goods must not be invented.
Glyph after Saturn and Mars on PDF410 could be lunar south node, but original glyph identity requires explicit confirmation before formalizing.
The buyer deceit claim continues a prior conditional across PDF410–411; not an independently observed psychological disposition.
Seller-deception statement is a separate seventh-house condition; no actual seller, fraud, or litigation case is authenticated.
Sun first-house clause explicitly excludes corporeal conjunction; the benefic Mercury/Moon option excludes malefic aspect.
Moon void-of-course has a strong-applying-significators exception, not a universal categorical impossibility.
Entering combustion of Moon-separated planet allegedly prevents property recovery forever; no timescale or real event verified.
The sign whose lord is beheld by the previously separated planet remains referentially ambiguous in the final repurchase clause.
The alternate repurchase outcome is conditional on BOTH planet free-from-misfortune and beholding sign lord.
PDF410–411 are copied original-page images from an earlier active worktree and SHA256-frozen; full-original-PDF pixel parity and blind diplomatic transcription not independently established.
Preceding LIII original-source acceptance remains unresolved; numbering, index integration, final archive admission and canonical promotion must wait.
